title: A Garden for the Wolf
author: Ines Hartwell
blurb: Ada Villalobos, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
